title: walk: inline image inside alt/mixed container has no test
description: mime-tree/src/walk.rs: when in_alternative=true and multipart_type != 'alternative', a non-text/plain, non-text/html part (e.g. image/gif) falls through to both text_body and html_body pushes since neither nullification branch fires. RFC 8621 §4.1.4 JS algorithm behavior for this case is not tested. Add a test: multipart/alternative → multipart/mixed → image/gif and verify textBody/htmlBody/attachments match RFC §4.1.4.
